title: Late-Refund Rate Addition on Universal Life Insurance Guideline Excess
content:
When guideline excess is refunded from an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy, a late-refund addition is added to the earnings rate on the excess according to the days since the excess payment (the most recent premium payment in the activity history) was received, counted to the date of the refund.

**Standard.**

- Received at least **60** days ago (the late full days): the late full rate, **2%** (0.02) a year, is added to the earnings rate.
- Received at least **45** days ago (the late partial days) but fewer than 60: the late partial rate, **1%** (0.01) a year, is added.
- Received fewer than 45 days ago: nothing is added.

**Boundary readings (hypothetical).**

| Days since the excess payment was received | Addition |
|---|---|
| 44 | none |
| 45 | 1% |
| 59 | 1% |
| 60 | 2% |
| 120 | 2% |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** An earnings rate of 4.25% with the excess received 63 days ago becomes 6.25%; with the excess received 50 days ago, 5.25%.
